doc: Known nano-vs-Zeebe trace divergences. Each entry: {scenario, issue: "#N", reason, ignoreRecords?}. A listed scenario that no longer diverges is STALE and fails engine-core/tests/zeebe_traces.rs — delete it. `ignoreRecords` (record-field matchers) narrows the entry: only matching records may differ; every other record of every step must still equal Zeebe.

entries.reason: Zeebe activates and completes each compensation boundary event (ELEMENT_ACTIVATING/ACTIVATED/COMPLETING/COMPLETED) before activating its handler; nano activates the handler directly without boundary-event lifecycle records.
